infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Alice connects to your G2 glasses over Bluetooth to read status, photo counts and button events.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Alice uses the glasses' microphone (or the iPhone's) for the voice assistant and translation.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Alice takes a photo when you ask it what you're looking at or to read a document.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Alice saves photos and videos imported from your glasses to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Alice lets you pick a glasses photo for the AI to describe.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Alice talks to the glasses' own Wi-Fi hotspot to transfer media.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Alice tells you where you are and starts directions when you ask.
infoPlist.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Alice creates reminders you ask for, after you confirm.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Alice creates reminders you ask for, after you confirm.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Alice adds calendar events you ask for, after you confirm.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: Alice adds calendar events you ask for, after you confirm.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Alice adds calendar events you ask for, after you confirm.
